label: Objection Rep
tagline: One real objection. Answer it with substance.
trains: Meeting a genuine objection about the piece in front of you with true facts — not a reflex discount, not something you made up.
pass_line: Pass when your answer is coherent and credible — real substance, no knee-jerk discount, nothing that contradicts the piece's documented story.

label: Price Defense
tagline: They want 20% off. Hold the line with value.
trains: Holding your price under pressure — leading with value instead of caving. Ten percent is the calibration ceiling.
pass_line: Pass when you concede nothing past 10% and make the value land.

label: Story Sprint
tagline: 60–90 seconds. Tell this piece's true story.
trains: Telling a piece's story cleanly in a minute — covering what matters and inventing nothing.
pass_line: Pass when the key documented beats land in 60–90s in a telling that holds together — anything extra you claim gets flagged for you to verify.

label: The Close
tagline: They're already sold. Ask for it — naturally.
trains: Reaching a clean, natural ask when the customer is already warm. No stalling, no pushiness.
pass_line: Pass when you ask for the sale, and it lands naturally.

label: Improv Practice
tagline: A piece that doesn't exist. Sell it anyway.
trains: Improvising when you don't know the story — a customer asks about a piece you've never seen. Keep the conversation alive with a story that flows, sparkles, and holds together. It's a game: the piece is invented.
pass_line: Pass when your story flows without freezing, carries specific vivid detail, and stays consistent under follow-ups — even though it's improvised.
